contentHtml:
In the latest build of the WoW Forever Beta, the Gnome racial ability Eureka! has received yet another nerf, this time now not working at all on periodic effects. The first nerf to Eureka was a flat percent reduction of its discount effect on resources.
View Original
Races
  • Gnome
    • Eureka! no longer benefits periodic effects at all. Channeled spells do not count as periodics.
This affects each eligible class slightly differently, and you can see the spell adjustments below.

Racial Traits (4)

  • Eureka!  Your next 3 non-periodic damaging abilities have their Energy cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage.
    • REMOVED Effect #3 Apply Aura: Modifies Periodic Damage/Healing Done
      Value: 10%
      Affected Spells:
      Garrote Rupture Garrote
      Garrote Garrote Rupture
      Rupture Rupture Rupture
      Rupture Garrote Garrote
      Rupture Rupture Rupture
      Garrote Garrote Garrote
      Garrote Garrote Garrote
      Rupture
    • Effect #3 Apply Aura: Dummy: Modifies Damage/Healing Done
      Value: 110
    • NEW Effect #4 Apply Aura: Dummy: Modifies Damage/Healing Done
      Value: 1
  • Eureka!  Your next 3 non-periodic damaging abilities have their Rage cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage.
    • REMOVED Effect #3 Apply Aura: Modifies Periodic Damage/Healing Done
      Value: 10%
      Affected Spells:
      Rend Rend Rend
      Rend Rend Rend
      Rend
    • Effect #3 Apply Aura: Dummy: Modifies Damage/Healing Done
      Value: 110
    • NEW Effect #4 Apply Aura: Dummy: Modifies Damage/Healing Done
      Value: 1
  • Eureka!  Your next 3 non-periodic damaging abilities have their Mana cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage.
  • Eureka!  Your next 3 non-periodic damaging or healing abilities have their Mana cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage or healing.

contentHtml:
With the level increase to 30 in today's beta build for WoW: Forever, players will be able to learn higher ranks of their professions. One profession in particular, though, got some adjustments to its crafted weapons: Enchanting.

Now, instead of having sell prices in silver, Enchanting-crafted wands are being nerfed to a 1 sell price regardless of level.
Blizzard

    • All crafted common and uncommon quality wands now sell at vendors for 1 copper.

Now, players will unfortunately only be able to use the wands as leveling fodder and actual gear, instead of flipping these wands for profit. Without accounting for the cost of materials gained through disenchanting, the vendor costs - and the potential profit and loss - show that this was previously a decent way to make some extra money if you were disenchanting greens you looted naturally.

contentHtml:
Blizzard has announced that they're investigating login issues for today's latest build of the WoW: Forever beta.
Blizzard
View Original
We’re aware of and working to address an issue that appears to be preventing testers from logging into the WoW: Forever Beta.

We will continue to work to fix this as swiftly as possible.
Players are getting stuck while retrieving characters, and some are able to make it in by just waiting out whatever the problem might be - but once a fix is in place, players should be able to start their leveling to 30 without issues. We'll update this post as we receive more information.

contentHtml:
In the latest WoW: Forever build, there's a new proc for Verigan's Fist, the Level 20 Paladin Weapon!

Verigan's Fist is the original level 20 weapon for Paladins, obtained from the The Test of Righteousness questline. With Forsaken Paladins now available in WoW: Forever, the Horde got a similar quest Old Fire-Eye which awards a similar weapon Wolfsbane. This weapon is a much more powerful version of the Alliance version of the weapon, as it also has a flat damage proc that does bonus damage to Worgen.

Wolfsbane
Item Level 31
Binds when picked up
Two-HandSword
69 - 105 Damage Speed 3.40
(25.59 damage per second)
+9 Stamina
+10 Intellect
Durability 100 / 100
Classes: Paladin
Chance on hit: Sear the target with a vortex of blazing wind, dealing 39 to 59 Holystorm damage. Deals 3 times as much damage to Wolves and Worgen.
Sell Price: 74 59


Some Alliance players, such as in this forum post, were upset at the imbalance between the factions and were hoping for an update to Verigan's Fist. In the latest WoW: Forever build, Verigan's Fist has gotten an update and now also includes a similar proc!

 
Holy Forgefire - Ignite the target in the flames of the Great Forge, dealing 39 to 59 Holyfire damage. Deals 3 times as much damage to Fire Elementals and Earth Elementals.

contentHtml:
Savory Whimsyfin Delight is a new recipe discovered in Redridge Mountains in the first phase of the Forever Beta. This is an Alliance version of the recipe found in The Barrens, Savory Deviate Delight.

While players had been delighted to discover new transformations from Savory Whimsyfin Delight, Blizzard has now advised that the Murloc and Ogre transformations were, in fact, just a placeholder effect and not intended for players,

Forever Cooking Overview


Instead, players should now notice that when they eat Savory Whimsyfin Delight, they will transform into Ninjas and Pirates just like Savory Deviate Delight, but with an Orc twist.
blizzard
Savory Whimsyfin Delight now uses an orc equivalent of the Ninja and Pirate outfits from the Savory Deviate Delight.

Developers’ notes: The prior transformations were placeholder, but we may reintroduce similar ones in the future!
